description: This file declares the CdmService class, which implements media decryption and Content Decryption Module (CDM) functionalities for the Rialto server. It includes method declarations for managing media keys, sessions, and decryption operations, as well as handling supported key systems and DRM store interactions.

classes.name: CdmService
classes.description: Implements the ICdmService and IDecryptionService interfaces, managing media key sessions, decryption, and DRM store interactions within the Rialto server.

methods.name: CdmService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CdmService with media keys factories.

methods.name: ~CdmService
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Activates the service.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Deactivates the service.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates media keys for a given handle and key system.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Destroys media keys associated with a handle.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session with specified parameters.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes a key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes a key session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in a session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM store.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Gets the LDL sessions limit.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM time.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns supported key systems.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption on encrypted media data.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the session uses PlayReady key system.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a session.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments usage counter for a session.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements usage counter for a session.
